description: Redirect retired and shorthand partner routes to the retained Partner Portal.
name: CCG retired Trade Partner Network redirects

rules.description: Permanently redirect public partner shorthands and retired Trade Partner Network pages to the retained portal.
rules.expression: ((((http.host in {"concreteconceptsgroup.com" "www.concreteconceptsgroup.com"}) and (http.request.uri.path eq "/partners" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/partners/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/trade-partners" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/trade-partners/"))) or http.host eq "trade.concreteconceptsgroup.com") and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"})

rules.description: Redirect other methods without replaying request bodies to the retained portal.
rules.expression: ((((http.host in {"concreteconceptsgroup.com" "www.concreteconceptsgroup.com"}) and (http.request.uri.path eq "/partners" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/partners/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/trade-partners" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/trade-partners/"))) or http.host eq "trade.concreteconceptsgroup.com") and http.request.method ne "GET" and http.request.method ne "HEAD")
